title: 3 Chinese among 5 caught in Tacloban over illegal health products

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Five individuals, including three Chinese nationals, were arrested in separate police operations against the alleged sale and distribution of unauthorized health products in Tacloban City on Thursday, with authorities seizing items valued at P96,205. Personnel of the Tacloban City Police Office–City Intelligence Unit and Police Station 2, in coordination with the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and the Bureau of Customs (BOC), conducted the raids in Barangay 40 along P. Burgos Street and Barangay 13, Shopping Center. Authorities said they arrested the suspects for alleged violations of Republic Act No. 9711, or the Food and Drug Administration Act […]...
